highlights.title: Make tracking harder across apps and sites.
Cut down on IP and DNS leaks.

features.title: Link scam scan
features.alt: Phone held in a public indoor space
features.copy: Quickly check sus links before you tap.
points: Check a suspicious link before opening it
Look for patterns associated with scams
Add a simple safety check to everyday browsing

features.title: Mask your IP
features.alt: Person using a phone in a city at night
features.copy: Traverse VPN hides your real IP address and routes your traffic through secure VPN servers, so websites and apps see the VPN location instead of your home or mobile IP. This makes it much harder for advertisers, data brokers, or bad actors to tie your browsing directly to your real device or physical location.
points: Replace your real IP with a Traverse VPN server IP
Add a layer of distance between your identity and the sites you visit
Make basic IP‑based tracking and targeting less effective

features.title: Protection against common leaks
features.alt: Phone in use in a public space
features.copy: Beyond basic encryption, Traverse VPN adds extra layers to reduce common ways your identity can slip through. These protections work together so your IP, DNS requests, and communication channels are harder to correlate and track in everyday use.
points: Reduce common ways your identity can slip through
Help keep IP and DNS requests private
Make communication channels harder to correlate and track

features.title: Smart protection for everyday browsing
features.alt: Phone held in a public indoor space
features.copy: Traverse VPN includes extra tools tailored to how people actually use the internet every day, not just raw tunneling. Link scam scanning – Check suspicious links for scam patterns and risky behavior before you open them, adding a buffer between you and phishing pages. These features complement the VPN tunnel to keep you safer against common traps like phishing, scam links, and confusing security settings.
points: Check suspicious links before opening them
Add a buffer between you and phishing pages
Complement the VPN tunnel with practical safety tools

features.title: Unlimited bandwidth
features.alt: Traveler working on a laptop at an airport
features.copy: Traverse VPN Pro offers unlimited bandwidth, so you don’t have to keep one eye on a data meter while you browse, stream, or download. Within normal usage limits, you’re free to stay connected as long as you like without worrying about pre-set caps.
points: No artificial data caps on premium plans
Stream, download, and browse without constantly checking usage
One less limit to think about when staying protected

features.title: Multi-device protection
features.alt: Laptop and travel essentials on a desk
features.copy: Traverse VPN is available for iPhone, iPad, and other Apple platforms, so you can protect more than one device with the same service. You can keep your phone protected on mobile data while your tablet or laptop stays secure on WiFi, using the same familiar interface across your Apple ecosystem.
points: Consistent experience across Apple devices
Protect multiple devices under the same subscription
Secure both mobile and WiFi usage in parallel

features.title: Streaming and travel-friendly
features.alt: People working together on laptops in a café
features.copy: When you’re traveling or using unfamiliar networks, Traverse VPN can help keep your streaming and browsing more private and consistent. Connect to a high-speed server in a suitable region, secure the hotel or airport WiFi, and stream or browse knowing your traffic is encrypted instead of exposed.
points: Extra privacy on hotel, airport, and café networks
More consistent streaming and browsing experience while abroad
Protection that travels with you instead of staying at home

More consistent streaming and browsing experience while abroad
Protection that travels with you instead of staying at home

features.title: Secure VPN for Public WiFi
features.alt: Traveler working on a laptop at an airport
features.copy: Auto-protect activates the moment you join any public network, cafes, airports, hotels, anywhere. You do not have to remember to turn it on. Traverse VPN does it for you.
points: Protection on cafés, airports, and hotel WiFi
Automatic protection when joining public networks
A simpler way to stay protected on the go

safeguards.title: Strong, Modern Encryption
safeguards.text: Your connection is protected with strong, modern VPN encryption designed to keep your traffic private on any network. Even when you’re on unsecured WiFi in cafés, airports, or hotels, Traverse VPN keeps your data inside an encrypted tunnel instead of letting it travel in readable form.
points: Encrypted tunnel between your device and Traverse VPN servers
Protection against casual snooping on open or shared WiFi
Extra peace of mind when handling logins, messages, and payments

safeguards.title: DNS Leak Protection
safeguards.text: Even with a VPN, DNS leaks can reveal which sites you visit to your internet provider or other third-party resolvers. Traverse VPN includes DNS Leak Protection so that your DNS lookups stay inside the encrypted tunnel instead of leaking out to the network.
points: Keep website lookups away from your ISP as much as possible
Make your browsing history and search activity harder to link back to you
Reduce one of the most common ways VPN setups accidentally expose data

safeguards.title: Kill Switch & Auto Connect
safeguards.text: If your VPN connection is interrupted, you don’t want your real IP address suddenly exposed in the middle of a session. Traverse VPN offers a Kill Switch that can block traffic whenever the VPN tunnel drops, helping to prevent accidental leaks while the app reconnects. Turn on Auto-connect and Traverse VPN will automatically secure your connection again so you stay protected with minimal effort.
points: Kill Switch to block traffic when the VPN disconnects
Auto-connect to restore protection automatically
Fewer gaps where your real IP could be exposed without you noticing

safeguards.title: Split Tunneling for more control
safeguards.text: Sometimes you want some apps to use the VPN and others to connect normally. Traverse VPN’s Split Tunneling feature lets you route selected apps through the encrypted tunnel while leaving others on your regular connection. This gives you more fine-grained control over how and where your traffic is protected.
points: Secure your browser and messaging apps with Traverse VPN
Keep certain local services or banking apps outside the tunnel if they require a local IP
Balance privacy, performance, and compatibility based on your own workflow

safeguards.title: Privacy Centric Design
safeguards.text: Traverse VPN Pro is built with a privacy-first mindset, not an ad-tech mindset. The premium experience is designed so that your VPN usage and browsing behavior are not turned into an advertising profile or packaged for third-party marketing. Traverse VPN’s in-app AI Chat is also described as not using your conversations to train the model, helping keep your questions and everyday chats from becoming training data.
points: No premium data-sharing promises for advertising
AI chat that isn’t used to build ad profiles or train external models
A VPN experience focused on protection, not monetizing your behavior

safeguards.title: High Speed Premium Servers
safeguards.text: Premium users can connect to Traverse VPN’s high-speed servers across multiple continents and countries, designed to support up to gigabit-class speeds where available. This gives you enough headroom for HD streaming, large downloads, and video calls when your own connection and device can keep up.
points: High-speed servers optimized for performance
Extra capacity for streaming, gaming, and remote work
Smarter routing to balance speed and security

safeguards.title: Easy to Use
safeguards.text: Security only works if you actually use it. The Traverse VPN apps are designed around one-tap protection: open the app, tap “Connect”, and your traffic is secured. This way, you get advanced security without needing to dig through complex menus or understand low-level networking.
points: One-tap connect to the best available server
Clear toggles for Kill Switch, WiFi Protection, Auto-connect, DNS Leak Protection, and Split Tunneling
A simple Premium User screen shows your plan and upgrade options at a glance

safeguards.title: Auto-connect and always-protected mindset
safeguards.text: Turn on Auto-connect and let Traverse VPN handle the routine work for you. The app can automatically secure your connection when you launch it or when you join new networks, so you’re not relying on memory to stay protected each time you go online.
points: Automatically secure new or risky networks
Reduce the chance of forgetting to turn the VPN on
Maintain a more “always-protected” posture with minimal effort
